question: On d1, trace the declared foreign key from HR.LOCATIONS to its parent, and that parent's foreign key to the next parent. Give each child table and column and referenced parent table and column, matching constraint column positions. Explain how a location reaches a region without assuming a direct region foreign key on LOCATIONS.

groundTruth.sql: SELECT c.table_name,cc.column_name,p.table_name,pc.column_name FROM all_constraints c JOIN all_cons_columns cc ON cc.owner=c.owner AND cc.constraint_name=c.constraint_name JOIN all_constraints p ON p.owner=c.r_owner AND p.constraint_name=c.r_constraint_name JOIN all_cons_columns pc ON pc.owner=p.owner AND pc.constraint_name=p.constraint_name AND pc.position=cc.position WHERE c.owner='HR' AND c.table_name IN ('LOCATIONS','COUNTRIES') AND c.constraint_type='R' ORDER BY c.table_name,cc.position
